name: Tillett Textiles
description: Before clients like Billy Baldwin, Albert Hadley, Babe Paley, and Jacqueline Kennedy Onassis discovered Tillett, the British-born Tillett brothers were printing fabrics in Cuernavaca, where their work caught the attention of the legendary Alexey Brodovitch at Harper's Bazaar. He sent d.d. Tillett to profile the brothers, and she soon fell in love with Leslie Tillett. Together they founded Tillett in 1946 and moved to the Upper East Side, living above their brownstone boutique and custom screen-printing atelier. There, the pair pioneered techniques such as drag box, wax resist, layering, and transparent inks to create painterly hand-printed fabrics prized by stylish clients.
